name: block-test-skips
description: Blocks newly added test skips and focus markers -- @pytest.mark.skip/skipif, @unittest.skip, it/describe/test.skip, xit/xdescribe, it/describe/test.only, JUnit @Disabled/@Ignore and Go t.Skip -- in test files, at commit and at agent tool-use. Only skips the change adds are judged (the engine compares findings with the baseline), so a skip already committed never blocks an unrelated edit. Companion of protect-test-integrity, which cannot see skips. Waivers: 'chock: allow test-skip' on the line is honoured at commit; in the agent, or for a commit with CHOCK_AGENT_COMMIT set, only a skip already committed in HEAD counts, so an agent that needs a new one must ask a person. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
